```{r}

library(scales)
library(tidyr)
library(mgcv)

library(mvgam)
```

#load data
```{r}
asv=read.table( "~/stats/median_asv_GAM_euc.csv", sep=",", row.names=1, header=TRUE, check.names=FALSE)
meta=read.table("~/stats/median_meta_GAM_euc.csv", sep=",", row.names=1, header=TRUE)
taxa=read.table("~/stats/median_taxa_GAM_euc.csv", sep=",", row.names=1, header=TRUE)

```


#Shannon index through time
```{r, eval=FALSE}

#create phyloseq object
ps=phyloseq(otu_table(asv, taxa_are_rows=TRUE), tax_table(as.matrix(taxa)), sample_data(meta))

#get shannon index
shannon = cbind(estimate_richness(ps,measures = 'shannon'),
            sample_data(ps))


#assign factor instread of chr
shannon$experience <- as.factor(shannon$experience)
shannon$bioreactor <- as.factor(shannon$bioreactor)
shannon$Sample_type <- as.factor(shannon$Sample_type)

#select only the first experiment
shannon1 <- shannon[shannon$experience == 'E1',]
#select rocks from first experiment
shannon1R <- shannon1[shannon1$short_sample_type == 'R',]

#select only the second experiment
shannon2 <- shannon[shannon$experience == 'E2',]

shannon2W <- shannon2[shannon2$short_sample_type == 'W',]

#renumber time so it goes from 1-24 instead of 22-45
shannon2W$time <- shannon2W$time-21
```

#visualize data (verify homoscedasticity)
```{r, eval=FALSE}
hist(shannon1R$Shannon)
summary(shannon1R$Shannon)

hist(shannon2W$Shannon)
summary(shannon2W$Shannon)
```


run model for sessile succession
```{r, eval=FALSE}
model1R_G_te <- gam(Shannon ~ te(dic, doc, bs = 'tp')  + s(time) + s(time, by = bioreactor, bs = 'tp', m = 1) + s(bioreactor, bs = "re"),  
method = 'REML', family = Gamma(link = identity),  gamma = 1, select = TRUE, data = shannon1R)                     
              
```


```{r, eval=FALSE}
draw(model1R_G_te, residuals = F)

gam.check(model1R_G_te, rep = 1000)

summary(model1R_G_te)


vis.gam(model1R_G_te, theta = 160, ticktype="detailed", type = 'response')

p <- plot_predictions(model1R_G_te, condition = c('time', 'bioreactor'), type = 'response',  points = 1, rug = F) #to get the shared+group trends

# Adjust the y-axis limits using ggplot2
p + ylim(0.95, 5) + theme_minimal() +
  theme(
   panel.grid = element_blank(),
    text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black") # Set axis text color to black
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "D")
```
```{r, eval=FALSE}
plot_predictions(model1R_G_te, condition = c('doc', 'dic'), type = 'response', points = 1, rug = TRUE)

plot_predictions(model1R_G_te, condition = c('dic', 'doc'), type = 'response',   points = 1, rug = TRUE)
```
```{r, eval=FALSE}
vis.gam(model1R_G_te, type = 'response', ticktype = 'detailed', theta = 180)

vis.gam(model1R_G_te, type = 'response', ticktype = 'detailed', theta = 270, se = 1)
```



create model for planctonic community exp. 2 (recolonization of sterile water)
  doc is removed as it is too highly correlated with time
```{r, eval=FALSE}
hist(shannon2W$Shannon)
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
shannon2W <- shannon2W %>% dplyr::select(c(dic, time, bioreactor, Shannon))


model2W_G_te <- gam(Shannon ~ te(dic, bs = 'tp', k = 10) + s(time, k = 15) + s(time, by = bioreactor, bs = 'tp', k = 10, m = 1) + s(bioreactor, bs = "re"),
method = 'REML', family = Gamma(link = identity),  gamma = 1, select = TRUE, data = shannon2W)                                     
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
gam.check(model2W_G_te, rep = 1000)

draw(model2W_G_te, residuals = F)

summary(model2W_G_te)
```
```{r, eval=FALSE}
p <- plot_predictions(model2W_G_te, condition = c('time', 'bioreactor'), type = 'response',  points = 1, rug = F)


# Adjust the y-axis limits using ggplot2
p + ylim(0.95, 5)  + theme_minimal() +
  theme(
   panel.grid = element_blank(),
    text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black") # Set axis text color to black
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "D")
```


```{r, eval=FALSE}
plot_predictions(model2W_G_te, condition = c('dic', 'bioreactor'), type = 'response',  points = 1, rug = TRUE)
```
